title: Settings
languageHint: Applies immediately to both windows and Master names.
adapterHint: Preselected on launch. Capture always starts manually.
invalid: Settings could not be loaded safely. Defaults are in use.
saveFailed: Preferences could not be saved. Previous settings are preserved.
loadFailed: Preferences could not be loaded. Defaults are shown.
reduceMotionHint: Turns off transitions. Windows' own animation setting is also respected.
clickThroughHint: Mouse input passes to the game underneath. To move the overlay, use Edit Mode below.
editModeHint: Temporarily accepts the mouse so you can drag and resize. Your settings return when you finish.
opacityHint: Affects the panel background only; text stays clear.
geometryReset: Saved overlay placement was invalid and has been reset.

licenses.intro: The fonts built into this application and their licenses. License terms are shown in their original language and are not translated.
licenses.linkFailed: The browser could not be opened. Go to the address manually.

usageOf.noto: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean
